title: Starter: chest CT with RT contours, chest radiograph, prostate MRI zones
description: Small committed pack so the app works from a clean clone: one thoracic radiotherapy-planning CT with RTSTRUCT organ-at-risk contours (lungs, heart, esophagus, spinal cord), one portable chest radiograph (CR, MONOCHROME1 rendering fixture) with the same patient's CT localizer, and one axial T2-weighted prostate MRI with manual zonal segmentation (DICOM SEG). Three different patients from three TCIA collections; no cross-collection links.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the structures delineated in this RT structure set are referenced (Esophagus, Heart, Left lung, Right lung, Spinal cord); all other anatomy and any pathology are unassessed.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: Radiotherapy organ-at-risk contours used clinically for treatment planning and reviewed/edited for consistency with the RTOG 1106 contouring atlas (LCTSC collection description). They are RT planning definitions, not necessarily anatomical teaching boundaries: the cranio-caudal start/stop levels and in-plane conventions (e.g. what is included with the heart, esophagus or cord) follow the RT atlas.
